title: One attempt at a goal: the rung the kernel resolved its difficulty to, the commit it builds from, and the builder spawned

goal.description: The goal's contract, by its path in the ledger.

difficulty.description: The attempt's difficulty, counted from 0, which the family's ladder resolves to a rung.

rung.description: The rung the difficulty resolved to: what the builder ran as.

harness.description: The harness the builder ran in, by its name in the limits.

image.description: The image the builder ran in, by name and digest.

seed.description: The commit the builder started from: the program branch's tip as read from the remote.

limits.description: The limits in force for the attempt, by their path in the ledger.
